intent: The crop-mode toolbar: an aspect-ratio split button, resize-to-fill, a zoom slider, and cancel / done. The host owns the document mutation and canvas geometry.
use_when: Editing an image or media crop.

tokens.note: DS tokens only; no hardcoded hex — verified.

a11y.aspect: SplitButton with a labelled aspect-ratio menu.

code.example:
<CropToolbar aspect={aspect} onAspectChange={setAspect} zoom={zoom} onZoomChange={setZoom}
  onResizeToFill={fill} onCancel={cancel} onDone={done} />
